div.div:
OOP Concepts Demonstrated:
• Abstraction: Account is abstract class
• Inheritance: SavingsAccount, CheckingAccount extend Account
• Encapsulation: Private (__), Protected (_) attributes
• Polymorphism: withdraw(), get_account_type() methods
• Composition: Customer has Accounts, Bank has Customers/Accounts
• Singleton Pattern: Bank class ensures single instance
• Factory Pattern: create_savings_account(), create_checking_account()
• Magic Methods: __str__, __repr__, __eq__, __lt__, __len__

div.div:
Design Patterns:
• Singleton Pattern: Bank class uses __new__ to ensure only one instance
• Factory Pattern: Static methods create different account types
• Template Method: Account defines common deposit() method
• Strategy Pattern: Different withdraw() implementations
